basics.name: Scott Anderson
basics.label: Cloud & Network Engineer
basics.summary: Infrastructure-focused IT engineer with cloud monitoring experience and a self-built production homelab spanning virtualization, segmented networking, and containerized services. Comfortable owning a system end to end — design, deployment, and the debugging that comes after. Currently pursuing a B.S. in Information Technology at WGU.

work.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
work.summary: Embedded with the monitoring team supporting enterprise services and systems.
highlights: Managed monitoring coverage for production services and server infrastructure using Dynatrace and Splunk, working alongside the cloud engineering team
Supported decommissioning of legacy software and end-of-life servers, including dependency review and removal of stale monitoring configuration
Partnered with development teams to onboard new services and servers into Dynatrace and Splunk, defining what to instrument and which conditions warranted alerting

work.name: Marvellous Catering
work.summary: Event operations while attending school full time.
highlights: Execute setup, service, and breakdown for high-volume events under fixed deadlines with no margin for rework
Coordinate directly with clients and crew in fast-moving environments where problems must be solved in the moment

work.name: Self-Employed
work.summary: Independent business acquiring, repairing, and reselling computer, server, and AV hardware.
highlights: Diagnose, repair, and refurbish laptops, desktops, servers, and audio equipment at the component level, including power supply, storage, and board-level faults
Evaluate hardware condition and market value to price inventory across KSL Classifieds, Facebook Marketplace, and eBay
Maintain 1–3 week turnaround from acquisition to sale while sustaining strong customer ratings
Guide customers through hardware and software troubleshooting in clear, non-technical language
